Title: Panic "capacity overflow" in read_guides on a FontLab Studio 5 file with global guides

Body:
**Note**: This post was generated by an AI agent (Claude) working under the guidance of @felipesanches, but submitted **without human review**. @felipesanches himself would still need to participate in the PR thread if he wants to contribute to the review.

Reading `StardosStencil-Bold.vfb` panics in `read_guides`; the Python vfbLib (0.11.7) decompiles the same file completely.

File: https://github.com/googlefonts/googlefontdirectory-hg/blob/52f780bc9d197280a9f430574e179a5f233c56b6/ofl/stardosstencil/src/StardosStencil-Bold.vfb (the Regular next to it reads fine).

Reproduce (vfbreader 0.1.5 as babelfont-rs main pins it; same with 0.1.6):

    babelfont StardosStencil-Bold.vfb out.glyphs

    thread 'main' panicked at library/alloc/src/raw_vec/mod.rs:28:5:
    capacity overflow
       4: vfbreader::guides::<impl vfbreader::buffer::EntryReader<R>>::read_guides
       5: vfbreader::entries::VfbEntry::new_from_reader
       6: vfbreader::buffer::VfbReader<R>::read_entry
       7: vfbreader::read_vfb

What the Python reader sees in that file: entry 1294 "Global Guides" decodes to horizontal guides with one position per master (`{'h': [[{'pos': 1025, 'angle': 0.0}], [{'pos': 905, 'angle': 0.0}], ...`), plus entry 1296 "Global Guide Properties" and 2031 "Glyph Guide Properties", both empty. The Regular has no guide entries at all, so the count read for the guides is the likely culprit (a `Vec::with_capacity` from a misread length).

I can test a fix against this file and the other 190 .vfb files of the Google Fonts library's FontLab-mastered families.
